content:
alex: Quick sync — release day checklist: marketing post + benchmark narrative + webinar CTA all need final links by EOD tomorrow. Can eng confirm changelog entry and canary timing? @jordan @tara
jordan: Changelog's ready, short blurb below. Canary starts Tue 2026-03-24 09:00 PT, 2-hour ramp then open to prod if no regressions. I'll post the release note link in a sec.
alex: Awesome — paste changelog here and a docs URL so we can link it in the tweet/thread.
jordan: Changelog:
```
- Add adaptive batching config and routing policies
- Improve KV cache warmup to reduce 95p latency
- Fix rare OOM during long-context generation
```
Docs draft: https://docs.redwood.ai/r/inference/2026-release-adaptive-batching (draft)
I'll mark it stable after final smoke.
tara: Docs looking good — can marketing link to /r/inference/2026-release and we'll set up a redirect once stable. Also uploaded webinar slide deck to Google: https://drive.google.com/xxx (view only)
sam: For webinar: want a short benchmark snapshot to highlight cost/latency improvements. Jordan, can you give 2 bullet numbers we can use on the slide?
jordan: Sure — 35% token-cost reduction on conv-gen workloads w/ prefix caching, p95 latency improved from 420ms -> 290ms on GPU fleet in staging. caveat: numbers from staging, expected +/-5% in prod.
alex: Perfect. Will author the launch post and include those numbers + link to docs. Need final doc link by EOD PST. Also need a one-line author byline for the post.
jordan: Author line: "Jordan Lee — Platform Engineering"
deploy-bot: Scheduled canary rollout for release/2026-03-24 at 09:00 PT. Watch: #eng-oncall
alex: Thanks — last ask: inbound lead routing — can we include UTM params? Tara can we add UTM campaign=2026-release&utm_source=announce
tara: Yep, will add redirect with UTM template and send final link here when done.
alex: Great. If no objections, I'll queue the social post and launch email for 14:00 PT on release day. :rocket:
jordan: No objections. I'll be on watch during canary.
alex: Closing — will post final links once Tara confirms. :thumbsup:
